# Publish the Anchors

> A minimal interoperability standard for text embedding spaces (Embedding Space Card, public anchor corpus, Adapter Manifest), with a cross-vendor migration study on German text. A vector index translated between embedding spaces with an orthogonal map keeps 88-96% of a full re-embed and is never better than keeping the old model. Author: Egbal Waldmann. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24484736.

The paper is written in Typst; every number in it is generated from the result files. Measures are nDCG@10, mostly relative to a full re-embed. The Archive testbed is private: only aggregate numbers are released.

## Paper

- [Paper as Markdown](paper/publish-the-anchors.md): full text, figures given by caption and description
- [Claims as JSON](paper/claims.json): the main findings with their numbers, units and sections
- [Paper as PDF](paper/publish-the-anchors.pdf): accessible (PDF/UA-1) and archival (PDF/A-2a)
- [Abstract](paper/abstract.txt)

- [Specification](spec/SPEC.md): Embedding Space Card, anchor corpus, Adapter Manifest, version 0.1
